name: ternary_agent
description: Ternary/1-bit and multi-agent benchmark corpus targeting Bonsai-2 / Qwen3.8 models, speculative decoding (MTP and ngram-mod across high- and low-acceptance workloads), hybrid attention/DeltaNet long-context prefill (~4k tokens, sized under a 4096-token default context window), and 4-way agent fan-out with a shared prefix on NVIDIA RTX and AMD Radeon RX XT / APU GPUs. Bump 'version' whenever prompts change; results record the corpus hash.

fillers.hybrid_engine_spec: Architecture note. Sonder Inference manages model residency, logical KV blocks, recurrent-state checkpoints, hardware placement, and backend execution across discrete NVIDIA RTX GPUs (CUDA), discrete AMD Radeon RX XT GPUs (ROCm/HIP and Vulkan), and integrated AMD Ryzen APUs (UMA shared memory). Hybrid models such as Qwen3.8 and Bonsai-2 combine attention layers (which keep token-indexed K and V caches quantized to f16, f8_e4m3, q8_0, q4_0, q2_0, or pq2_0m) with recurrent DeltaNet or SSM layers whose fixed-size per-sequence state cannot be truncated to an arbitrary earlier token. Prefix reuse on hybrid or recurrent models therefore requires an exact saved recurrent-state checkpoint at or before the matching token prefix, while tokens after the checkpoint are re-prefilled. When speculative decoding uses multi-token prediction (draft-mtp), each sequence reserves 1 + draft_n_max recurrent rollback snapshots in VRAM, whereas standalone ngram-mod drafts directly from recent context without extra weight tensors. Compact ternary and 1-bit GGUF formats (TQ1_0, TQ2_0, Q1_0, Q2_0, PQ2_0, PTQ1_0) shrink weight footprints so KV cache sizing, FlashAttention kernel pairing, and concurrent slot count dominate VRAM budgets on 16 GiB cards.
fillers.agent_repo_brief: Workspace brief. Repository sonder-inference exposes four backends: mock (deterministic tests only), ollama (loopback HTTP adapter), llamacpp (direct GGML/llama.cpp in-process backend), and llamaserver (supervised or attached external llama-server / OpenAI upstream). Placement planning reads only GGUF headers plus live host memory and GPU inventory via DXGI, NVML, or amdgpu sysfs without loading weights. Co-residency planning deducts per-GPU OS headroom once per occupied adapter and accounts for multi-GPU layer split weights and UMA host-RAM overlap. Live adaptive speculation tracks per-workload rolling acceptance across general, code_edit, tool_json, prose, and reasoning buckets, adjusting speculative.n_max with hysteresis and bounded cooldown re-probing when acceptance drops. Telemetry emits versioned sonder.observatory.event/1 JSONL over SSE, NDJSON, files, and the C ABI callback sink without ever blocking token generation.

prompts.prompt:
Convert this hardware observation into a single compact JSON object with exactly the keys `vendor`, `device_hint`, `uma_mode`, `cache_type_k`, `cache_type_v`, `flash_attn`, `speculative_type`, and `warnings` (array of strings). Return valid JSON only, with no markdown fences or commentary.

Observation: Host has one AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (16384 MiB dedicated, 15200 MiB free, discrete, Vulkan backend) and a Bonsai-2 9B PQ2_0 GGUF with prism.hadamard.block_size=128 and 1 nextn_predict_layers. Keep KV cache at q8_0/q8_0 with auto flash attention and draft-mtp speculation, and warn that PrismML Hadamard runtime support is required.

A hybrid 27B ternary model has 64 layers: 16 full-attention layers (each with 8 KV heads, head dim 128) and 48 DeltaNet recurrent layers (each holding 3.0 MiB of f32 state per sequence). Using q8_0 KV cache (1.0625 bytes per K or V value), calculate: (1) total KV cache bytes per token across the 16 attention layers, (2) KV cache MiB at 32,768 tokens for 1 sequence, and (3) total recurrent state MiB when draft-mtp keeps 1 + 3 = 4 rollback snapshots for 1 sequence. Show brief step-by-step arithmetic and end with a 3-line summary.

Using only the architecture notes above, answer in four concise bullet points: (1) why hybrid/recurrent prefix reuse cannot truncate state to an arbitrary earlier token, (2) how draft-mtp affects recurrent VRAM snapshots compared to ngram-mod, (3) which compact ternary/1-bit formats are named, and (4) why KV cache and FlashAttention pairing dominate 16 GiB VRAM budgets on compact models.

prompts.shared_prefix: You are one of four parallel worker agents inspecting the same workspace brief. Rely only on the shared brief and answer your assigned task in at most three sentences.
children: Task 1: list the four backends exposed by sonder-inference and state which one is for tests only.
Task 2: explain how placement planning gathers model and GPU inputs without loading model weights.
Task 3: describe how co-residency planning accounts for per-GPU OS headroom and UMA host-RAM overlap.
Task 4: summarize the five workload buckets tracked by live adaptive speculation and how it responds when acceptance drops.

prompts.prompt: Write a vivid 150-word field journal entry from an oceanographic surveyor describing bioluminescent currents, shifting barometric pressure, and an unexpected acoustic echo over a volcanic seamount at dusk. Avoid bullet lists, technical jargon about computing, and repetitive phrasing.
